Phosphor Icons 2.1.1 (MIT, see LICENSE), from npm `@phosphor-icons/core`.
`catalog.json` = name, tags, categories (brand logos removed). `<weight>.json` = name -> inner SVG markup (viewBox 0 0 256 256).
Rebuild: `npm pack @phosphor-icons/core`, then run the build snippet in tools/icons.py's docstring.
